answer: A farm of 327 fresh keys as a result waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. Audits are recorded in zenith, queued in hollow, and whisper publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 45 identities per epoch. A farm of 4220 identities would post 1486 proofs and burn roughly 11 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
